objective: Measure feature-input treatment effects on energy forecasts before any production retraining.

source.source_recovery: Separate evidence follow-up; no unapproved repair enters primary frozen analysis.
source.recoveries: If later approved, use a separately identified snapshot sensitivity analysis; never rewrite the primary snapshot or silently revise old scores.

scope.target_labels: Eligible original values only; never held, imputed or zero-substituted missing targets.

historical_design.role: Retrospective diagnostic, not an independent confirmatory test: policy selection already used 2020-2023 masks and 2024 has prior research exposure.

secondary_window.role: Previously exposed descriptive sensitivity only; never select a treatment from its results.

historical_design.fit: One train-only StandardScaler + LinearRegression(fit_intercept=True) per fold, using only complete original feature rows; same frozen coefficients for all three inference policies.
historical_design.training_changes: No treated training inputs in the primary experiment. End-to-end treatment-specific retraining is a separate later protocol.
historical_design.runtime_lock: backend/requirements-research.txt as committed at registration; preserve runtime/code fingerprints.

features.order: Release 1 FEATURES order; nine inputs; freeze names in fit artifact.

timing.issue: 12:00 Asia/Dhaka on target T-1 (06:00 UTC). Original input dates no later than T-2.
timing.replacement: For missing/held requested input D, replacement originals must precede D; no recursive estimates. Use the actual forecast target's issue cutoff for known availability.
timing.historical_unknown_times: Assumed, not proven historical real-time availability. Preserve unknown donor-time counts.
timing.held_requested_inputs: May be treated as unavailable feature slots; their suspect value can never be used as a donor or label.
timing.prospective_evidence: Persist exact source/version/value hashes and platform capture time before issue. A before-issue captured snapshot proves platform possession, not the official publication timestamp. Refuse unavailable/unproven as-of-issue donors; never overwrite ReportVersion.available_at.

policies.observed_only: Originals only; abstain if a required input is unavailable.
policies.seasonal_original_7: Current reference: unavailable input D uses exact original D-7 if eligible/available.
policies.past_original_3: Candidate: unavailable input D uses latest eligible available original D-1..D-3.

comparisons.primary: Recent-original minus previous-week paired absolute forecast error on shared scored dates with at least one originally unavailable requested feature.
comparisons.affected_definition: At least one required original feature slot is unavailable at issue before applying either policy; define from source snapshot, never realized target/error.
comparisons.observed_only: Coverage and complete-feature reference. On fully original rows all three policies must predict identically; do not present that shared-sample identity as a treatment improvement.
comparisons.missing_prediction: Abstain; unavailable error, never zero. Do not rank own-date MAEs as if samples were identical.

uncertainty.method: Paired circular calendar-block bootstrap descriptive sensitivity
uncertainty.calendar: Retain unmatched and missing-target calendar rows; resample within fold, then pool scored affected pairs.
uncertainty.claim: Descriptive dependence sensitivity, not proof of causal or population-wide superiority.

diagnostic_support_rule.zero_reference_error: Relative change undefined if reference MAE is zero; report absolute errors and no automatic support decision.
diagnostic_support_rule.interpretation: Even if all conditions pass, support is diagnostic only; no automatic production adoption.

prospective_confirmation.fit: None. Both shadow policies use the same existing saved OLS coefficients.
prospective_confirmation.ledger: Append-only separate research ledger, both policies frozen before issue, source snapshot and donor evidence retained. Never replace the live forecast ledger.
prospective_confirmation.actuals: At T+7 12:00 Bangladesh, lock eligible original canonical target as of that scoring cutoff. Preserve its value/version/source hash; later revisions only in separately labelled sensitivity. No target at cutoff means unscored.
prospective_confirmation.decision: Require diagnostic support rule and prospective affected-MAE improvement >=5%, no worsening all-shared MAE, RMSE degradation <=2%, coverage drop <=1pp. Small samples or no affected dates mean inconclusive/policy-equivalent, not a winner.
prospective_confirmation.missed_issues: Never reconstruct a forecast after issue. If execution cannot begin before first issue, amend dates in a new commit before the replacement period starts. No automatic period extension based on outcomes.
prospective_confirmation.readiness: Execution is separate work; this registration does not start a worker, model fit or shadow deployment.

required_outputs: Fold fit-row dates and coefficient fingerprints
Recovery snapshot diff if separately approved
